===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Instructor Ng]].
* Complete the [[Advanced Defense Techniques]] course.
* Complete the [[Disruption]] course.
* Complete the [[Skill Chaining]] course.
* Complete the [[Snaring Course|Snaring]] course.
* See Headmaster Vhang for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 75 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==

The completion of this quest requires the completion of four sub-quests given also by Instructor Ng. The order of completion is entirely optional.

Over level 10 fire elementalists can kill the opponents easily. Use [[Fireball]], [[Lava Arrows]] and [[Fire Storm]] and they will become passive in a while.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
;Headmaster Vhang
:''"You are ready to earn your Elementalist Insignia? All right, then. This advanced training is designed to teach you how to use the power of Earth, Air, Fire, and Water to overcome your foes. The Elementalist is a powerful damage-dealer and must learn to control the elements and bend them to her will. Speak with '''Instructor Ng''' to begin."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I am ready to earn my Elementalist Insignia.
| decline = I am not ready yet.
| ask = It was my understanding that you wished to become an expert Elementalist. Speak with '''Instructor Ng''' to begin training for your Elementalist Insignia.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Vhang
:''"Congratulations. You have earned your Elementalist Insignia. You are now an expert Elementalist. May the powers of Earth, Air, Fire, and Water serve you well."''
